svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: How a case moves from intake to a committed, audited decision. Claude reads and drafts, code decides facts and permissions, humans decide anything legal.
adds the X-Actor header, TanStack Query
thin, permissions checked on the server
rules and date math as pure functions
rerun for that case only. Prior human decisions are kept, never edited.
quote must exist on the page
Every green dot writes one line through audit.record(), in the same transaction as the change.
One chain per case plus a SYSTEM chain. A trigger blocks UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE.
GET /api/cases/{id}/audit/verify recomputes the chain and reports the first broken seq.
model and effort live here, not in code
key, version, model, tokens, input hash
cache by file sha256 + prompt version
No legal advice, no filing, no sending. Drafts are DRAFT_NOT_SENT, forms NOT FOR FILING.
Every query is scoped by case_id. Unclear ownership means the document is quarantined.
A value is verified only when code finds its quote in the source text.
Deadlines come only from a verified portal event plus 10 days, computed by code.
